source: the model header (Trace conformance) and its SigmaObs/H definitions
hidden: H = diff(Events, SigmaObs): rounds, a_en results 0/1, a_dis, a_chk/w_chk, signals, p_sig, p_rel, w_xw, a_self, stale flags, idle, bound_exceeded
projection: one Alternative object with its two rendezvous channels and their partners

configurations.name: SYSM per select
requires: two rendezvous input guards, one plain writer each, no other reader or Alternative on them
checked per select(): one select, each writer with at most one message pending
no limit on rounds: the round budget (RBUD(1, 1) = 6 per run) is never reached in this system (deadlock freedom, #23), so it removes no behaviour

events.model: a_sel.g.b.o; b: a RendezvousDone on c_g with A as reader in the select's window; o: one on the other channel

events.trace: the Resume ending writer g's wait after A took its offer

generator: per-select checks of two-input Alternatives with plain writers (e.g. T12)
gaps: a_act.i.1 (claimed before) and a_act.i.2/.3 (taken or claimed now) end in the same RendezvousDone; a trace does not say which
enable/disable results and state words are not recorded

check_alphabet.observed: a_sel, w_done, a_wait (renamed awt), w_towait, w_wait, a_towait.true (renamed atw)
check_alphabet.hidden for the check: p_out (the offer's critical section lies between the writer's first Resume and its second WaitChannel: its recorded position is not exact), a_towait.false (no record)
